  revoke                 Revoke an existing keyset
  dump                   Inspect local key material and server keysets
  mfa                    Multi-factor authentication operations

Description:
  Authenticate interactively through the browser via Passport, or with --login/--pwd for credential login

Usage:
  Auth.Client.Cli login [options]

Options:
  --force                                  Force re-login even if token is still valid
  --login <login>                          Email to use for credential-based login (bypasses the browser)
  --pwd <pwd>                              Password in plain text; prompted interactively when --login is set and --pwd is omitted
  --totp <totp>                            Verify an existing TOTP enrolment after credential login
  --totp-setup                             Run the interactive 3-step TOTP enrolment flow after credential login
  --expected-audience <expected-audience>  Validate the minted token's audience against this value instead of the default
  --resource <resource>                    Resource indicator (RFC 8707) binding the minted token's audience; requires --login
  --jwt                                    Print only the bare access token to stdout (for scripting); mutually exclusive with --json
  -?, -h, --help                           Show help and usage information
  --root <root>                            Root directory for CLI settings and keyset files [default: ./.auth-cli/]
  --json                                   Emit machine-readable JSON output

Description:
  Administer the service-client registry (operator API key required)

Usage:
  Auth.Client.Cli service client [command] [options]

Options:
  -?, -h, --help  Show help and usage information
  --root <root>   Root directory for CLI settings and keyset files [default: ./.auth-cli/]
  --json          Emit machine-readable JSON output

Commands:
  register  Register a service client; prints the generated secret ONCE
  secret    Manage a client's secrets (dual-secret rotation)
  disable   Disable a client; its next token request fails
  enable    Re-enable a disabled client
  delete    Delete a client entirely; prefer 'disable' for offboarding (keeps the audit witness)
  list      List registered clients (no secret material)
  show      Show one registered client (no secret material)
